summary: Frontend-only verification of Songs-tab management-list incremental reveal cap (songsVisibleCount). Seeded library to 161 songs via /api/songs, logged in as test@test.com, and exercised all 6 acceptance criteria via Playwright. All checks pass with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js remains ~16.7k lines; the songsVisibleCount cap adds only a few lines but the MusicianDashboard component is still monolithic - consider extracting SongsManagementList into its own component.
The reset-on-filter-change is coupled to filterSongs()'s effect; if new filter dimensions are added later, ensure they also trigger setSongsVisibleCount(100) so the cap stays consistent.
seed_data_creation: Created 140 additional songs via POST /api/songs titled 'LoadTest Song 001'..'LoadTest Song 140' with artists 'LoadTest Artist 0..19'. Library total went from 21 -> 161. Safe to delete; all have LoadTest prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verification results for the incremental-reveal cap: (1) Initial render caps at 100 rows even with 161 total songs; (2) 'Your Songs (161)' header shows FULL filtered total, not 100; (3) [data-testid=songs-show-more] visible with label 'Show next 100 (showing 100 of 161)'; (4) Clicking Show More reveals remaining rows (100 -> 161) and the button disappears when cap >= total; (5) Typing 'LoadTest' in the filter search resets cap to 100 (rows 100 of 140 filtered), Show-more re-appears with label 'Show next 100 (showing 100 of 140)'; (6) Clearing filter resets and cap remains at 100 with header updating to full total; (7) No console errors, no freeze. Select All label present and functional. Header count consistently uses filteredSongs.length (full filtered total). Cap logic at App.js L7410,7453-7461 and songsVisibleCount state L934 is correct.
